criteria.evidence: Turn 0 reply presents five numbered findings each citing a file and line (e.g. `.github/workflows/cleanup-pr-image.yml:59`, `docs/build.mjs:47`).

User redefined finding 1 as the !cancelled()/setup gating; turn 1 adds `needs.setup.result == 'success'` to verify-published, update-description, record-image and create-github-release (diff confirms).
Turn 2: matrix-emission shell consolidated into new `.github/actions/image-matrix/action.yml`, used by release.yml, build.yml and cleanup-pr-image.yml.
Turn 3: `all` now `{name}` for verify-published; new `described` `{name, shortDescription}` consumed only by update-description.
Turn 3: repeated #521/#544 recaps removed from release.yml, cleanup-pr-image.yml; one mention kept in action description.
Diff removes build.yml comment 'setup supplies the image matrix. This job used to run in parallel...'.
Turn 9: 'Working tree is clean. Seven commits on the branch now'.
Turn 4: 'I could not push: this repo has no remote configured' with commits left ready; user accepted.
Turn 5 rewrote the moved comment to two natural lines; later removed entirely in turn 9.
Turn 9: comment removed in `71e5176`; final diff shows no setup-job header comment in cleanup-pr-image.yml.
Diff removes 'Read-only permissions by default', per-scope permission comments, fetch-depth/fetch-tags restatements, 'Push path...' and fail-fast restatements.
Concurrency rationale and each consumer's '!cancelled() so a failed release job doesn't skip...' comments retained in final diff.
Turn 7 trims #Image comment to the Windows-exclusion rationale and the rejected-disjunction note; diff confirms.
Turn 8 removes the build.yml cross-reference comment; diff shows the two lines deleted.
Replay reports all four YAML files parse and the extracted script was run against config/images.json byte-for-byte; `cue` not installed, schema change is comment-only.
Turns 5/6/8/9 verify gates, matrix refs, permission scopes and checkout inputs unchanged; diff shows comment-only deltas in those commits.

Final release.yml retains only rationale comments (concurrency, !cancelled, setup gating, Scout/Windows, description coverage); the `target`/`name` note explains stage mapping not visible in the workflow.

judge.reason: The replay's initial review differed from the original but the user redefined each finding explicitly and the replay implemented all of them: setup-result gating, a shared composite action, split all/described matrices, comment pruning across release.yml, build.yml, cleanup-pr-image.yml and schema.cue, with commits on the branch and push reported impossible. Doubt remains over reading the finding-number criteria against the user's redefinitions, over whether the retained release-linux matrix comment is purely descriptive, and over cue vet not being runnable.
